# Cod Xpert Invoices (https://invoice.codxpert.com)

> Enterprise Statutory Foreign Currency Invoicing, GST LUT Exemption & Real-Time Forex Variance Platform for Global Exporters, Small Businesses, Agencies, Freelancers & Contractors. Engineered by CodXpert (https://codxpert.com/).

## Core Capabilities
- **GST LUT 0% IGST Export Billing:** Automated statutory Letter of Undertaking (LUT) declarations pursuant to Rule 96A of CGST Rules 2017 / Section 16 of the IGST Act. Prevents working capital blockage on cross-border shipments.
- **Multi-Currency Engine:** Real-time exchange rate sync via ExchangeRate-API (USD, AED, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD) with manual override capabilities to lock exact invoice-date interbank rates.
- **Forex Variance & FIRC / e-BRC Reconciliation:** Logs exact bank liquidation dates, realized INR values, and automatically accounts for realized Forex gains (credits) or losses (debits) with FIRC reference tracking.
- **Recurring Invoices & Retainer Billing:** Set cadence, automated dispatch, and payment reminders for monthly agency retainers and client contracts.
- **Invoice Tracking & Status Telemetry:** Track delivery, view dates, aging breakdown, and automated chasing of overdue invoices.
- **Estimates & Quotation Conversion:** Issue professional quotes and convert approved estimates to tax invoices in 1 click.
- **GSTR-1 Tax Portal Export:** One-click CSV generation pre-formatted for direct Chartered Accountant and GST portal filing under Table 6A.
- **Business Expense & Input Tax Credit (ITC) Tracker:** Digital receipt uploads with automatic tax breakdown and Excel exports.
- **Custom Per-User SMTP Mailer:** Isolated, domain-verified SMTP delivery with AES-256 encrypted credentials preventing spam flagging.
- **Free Instant Invoice Generator:** Browser-based client-side and server-backed invoice maker with instant PDF download.
- **Statutory Compliance:** Compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
